title: Stained Glass Radiance
description: A mixed-media artwork depicting a stylized human face with an open mouth at the center, wearing a blue fan-like headdress. The composition is framed by a broken stained glass window with colorful fragments in blue, green, orange and yellow, featuring a bright yellow sun at the top and blue rays emanating from the figure's right eye, with flowers growing across the torso.
prompt: Surreal mixed-media painting of a stylized human face with open mouth centered in a broken stained glass window. The figure wears a blue fan headdress, has one eye visible while the other emits intense blue rays across the composition. Yellow sun sits at the top, flowers with green stems grow across the chest and neck. Fragmented stained glass border in blue, green, orange and yellow surrounds the scene with visible cracks and shards.
medium: Watercolor, marker and colored pencil on paper
